title: Theal
desc: A merciless debt collector confronts an unforeseen dilemma when a woman arrives in his life, asserting that she is his mother.

title: Pallandu Vazhga
desc: An old couple living with their grandson yearn for the love of their children, who live abroad and hardly visit them. The frustrated couple hatch a plan to make their children come home.

title: Subham
desc: The women of Bheemili are unusually transfixed by a soap opera serial. When three friends who run the cable in town decide to dig into the situation, they uncover unimaginable secrets.

desc: A young man is looked down upon by his father due to his irresponsible behaviour. He soon gets embroiled in a tussle with an egoistic gangster who threatens his family.

title: Skanda
desc: A skilled martial artist's life changes when a secret agency recruits him to stop terrorists. He faces a dangerous mission that will test his abilities and courage beyond anything he is known.

title: Maamannan
desc: A father and his son must reconcile their differences and face their past in order to defeat a late politician's privileged son, who is out to humiliate them.
